verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only domain-specific scheduled automation: dunning lets users schedule payment retries and reminder emails at intervals, and subscriptions bill automatically on recurring periods. Export jobs are asynchronous one-off jobs, not scheduled ones. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined job or workflow scheduler, cron-like scheduling via API/SDK/MCP, documentation of workflow automation beyond billing and dunning, and independent corroboration.
